headline: Indian Rupee Draws Support as Foreign Portfolio Investors Surge Inflow
summary: Foreign portfolio investors bought ₹14,796 crore worth of Indian stocks in the largest daily inflow since 2021, providing strong support to the Indian rupee amid easing oil prices and a global tech-sector rout.
why: Sudden spikes in foreign capital inflows strengthen domestic currency valuations and shift sentiment toward emerging market equities.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Record daily equity inflows from FPIs support the Indian rupee and local market stability.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Massive foreign institutional stock purchases created strong demand for the local currency, offsetting headwinds from external technology routs.
